summary: Add deterministic MIME-derived extensions to fallback attachment names so supported unnamed imports remain analyzable.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email adaptability
FR-INGEST-006 requires selected attachments to pass through the normal immutable upload path
Offline reproduction showed an imported unnamed text/plain resource routing to UNSUPPORTED because its fallback name had no extension
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: The declared MIME type controls only a fallback extension; supplied filenames are preserved after existing sanitization.
A MIME-derived extension does not prove the bytes match the declaration; normal parsers still validate or fail closed.
Unsupported content types remain unsupported even when the standard library supplies an extension.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or provider API is used.
